title: Lab · Brett Boggs
heading: Lab
lede: Experiments and unfinished things, allowed to be rough.

entries.title: Slumbio
entries.desc: A sleep app for iOS. Thirty-three of its thirty-five sounds are built as they play, so there is no loop to hear.

entries.title: The MacArthur
entries.desc: A rail bridge approach in St. Louis, rebuilt to scale from public data so the job could be stood in.

entries.title: The Field
entries.desc: The grass above. Every blade is a spring on your GPU, and the cursor is weather.

entries.title: Keepsake
entries.desc: A seeded drawing of a field, different for every visitor. Yours to keep.

entries.title: Sprout Siege
entries.desc: An idle farm game for iOS, built around a simulation core that never touches the screen.

entries.title: The Ridge
entries.desc: A golden hour flyover, rendered in Blender and scrubbed by scroll. It runs the front page.

entries.title: The Underground
entries.desc: The same ground as the Ridge, cut open six metres to rock. Roots grow as you scroll.

entries.title: The Bridge
entries.desc: A cable-stayed crossing that surveys, drafts, and builds itself as you scroll. Datum’s first landing film.

entries.title: The Drafting Film
entries.desc: A highway underpass you draft by scrolling. It ran Datum’s landing page for one night.
